description: Vector4: add, sub, neg, scale, dot, norms, normalize, lerp, angle, component-wise ops, min / max

format.tolerance_unit: raw units (1 ulp = 2^-32), applies to every output scalar

ops.name: vector4_scale
ops.tolerance: expected = floor(exact result), computed on i128 raws; 0: one rescale per output scalar reproduces it bit for bit

ops.name: vector4_dot
ops.tolerance: expected = floor(exact result), computed on i128 raws; 0: one rescale per output scalar reproduces it bit for bit

ops.name: vector4_norm_squared
ops.tolerance: expected = floor(exact result), computed on i128 raws; 0: one rescale per output scalar reproduces it bit for bit

ops.name: vector4_normalize
ops.tolerance: ceil(2 + 2 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: vector4_angle
ops.tolerance: ceil(16 + 8 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: vector4_component_mul
ops.tolerance: expected = floor(exact result), computed on i128 raws; 0: one rescale per output scalar reproduces it bit for bit
